notes: No NEW original numerical cohort recovered. Existing beta, Reddit, Wowhead studies and Xenastro log imports must not be counted twice. New independent rank-mapping cross-publisher check: GoldCap and WoW Price Hub both label Serevite 190395=R1,190396=R2,190394=R3; Saddlebag Exchange instead labels 190394=R1,190395=R2,190396=R3 and contains unrelated auto-generated lore, making it a conflicting low-trust secondary source. Treat quality map as cross-site corroboration only, not authoritative game tooltip/Blizzard item-service confirmation. Xenastro rendered workbook exposes summary percentages/distribution, not raw Prospecting Log rows 28/33/39/54/62, so cannot resolve completed casts or per-output 0-N histograms from summary percent values. All unobserved castsWithDrop, zero outcomes, histograms, refund-adjusted operations, output ranks and skill/patch fields remain unknown; no P(hit), gold prices, or cast count inferred.
